about: Solar panel dust tuning (DESIGN.md 'Solar panel dust'; docs/design/balance-sheet.md §2a, approved draft with SME refinements). Every value here is an invented game-balance number unless its tag says otherwise. Timing scales with pace.rateMultiplier; no physical threshold is touched.

stage_interval_sols.note: About 15 times faster than real (real arrays lose about 0.2 % of output per sol, searched); the journal says so. Phase 2 3.75, Phase 3 6, Equilibrium 12 sols follow from dividing by the storm cap.

output_by_stage_percent.note: Stage 4 is a floor; optimistic against InSight's fall to about 10 % (journal note).

partly_cleaned.note: From stage 4 (60 %) to 80 %; stage 3 (70 %) to 85 %; stage 2 (82 %) to 91 %.

storm_end.note: Added when the storm ends, never before (keeps the F1 lock point clean). A design choice, not science.

dust_devil.note: Real Spirit about 0.15 % per sol (calc). Rolled in simulation time with a seeded RNG (ARCHITECTURE.md 2.17).

local_dust.note: Plausible; the only real support is landing plumes (searched).
